top.lead: A database of the world's railway vehicle classes, linked to body models made for 3D printing.
top.findPlaceholder: Class name (e.g. ICE T, Class 66, TGV)

search: Filter the world's classes by country, operator, manufacturer and more.
map: See where each class runs and browse from the map.
view: Turn each body around on its class page, with notes on the parts.
download: GLB, STL, 3MF and more, for 3D printing or CAD.
data: Class data as RDF and 3D models as IIIF.

about: We collect railway vehicle classes (groups of vehicles built to the same design) from Wikidata and other authorities. Japanese classes are not included.
The 3D models are bodies designed to fit a toy chassis. They are not scale models. Each model is linked to the class and livery it depicts.

models: Name, size, Wikidata class ID, date added
rdf: One file per class, and one for all
iiif: One per 3D model, and a Collection of all

view.title: 3D viewer
view.description: List and 3D viewer of 3D-printed train and bus bodies that sit on a toy chassis.
view.lead: Bodies made for 3D printing, sized to sit on a toy chassis.
view.moved: The 3D models are now shown on the page of each class.
view.hint: Drag to turn, scroll to zoom
note: Sizes are the outer dimensions of the body (length × width × height, mm). Colours show the livery; prints are single-colour. Sized to fit a toy chassis.
Liveries and logos are based on photos on Wikimedia Commons.
